newsitem.title: USA: Southcap says ends United Home Life offer.
newsitem.headline: Southcap says ends United Home Life offer.

text.p: SouthCap Corp said Wednesday it ended on Tuesday its tender offer for all the outstanding shares of common stock of United Home Life Insurance Co.
The company said no shares were purchased through the tender offer of $7.00 per share because certain conditions were not satisfied. No further information was immediately available.
Southcap said the depositary, Fifth Third Bank, Cincinnati, will return to participating shareholders all United Home Life shares tendered in connection with the tender offer.
Southcap said United Home Life announced on May 15 it had entered into a letter of intent to be acquired by United Farm Family Life Insurance at a price of $8.75 per share of common stock.
SouthCap said it may, in the future, buy United Home Life common stock on the open market or in privately negotiated transactions.
